name: datn-agent
description: DATN workstation agent — Rust core + desktop control panel

scripts.chrome-bridge:install: cd desktop && npm run build && node dist/service/install-chrome-bridge.js
scripts.build:desktop: cd desktop && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:cloak-runner && npm run build:chrome-bridge && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && cd desktop && npm run dev
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:core && node scripts/ensure-cloak-dir.js && cd desktop && npm run dist
scripts.service:install: cd desktop && npm run build && node dist/service/install.js
scripts.service:uninstall: cd desktop && npm run build && node dist/service/uninstall.js
scripts.clean: rimraf bin desktop/dist desktop/release desktop/node_modules core/target
